joystickEventName.description:
The joystick event name for the UI position for the base and stick elements.
The event name is appended with the side: 'left' or 'right'.
joystickEventName.title: Joystick Base Event Name

focusDamping.name: focusDamping
focusDamping.description:
The focus damping. A higher value means more damping. A value of 0 means no damping.
The damping is applied to the orbit mode.
focusDamping.title: Rotate Damping

rotateDamping.name: rotateDamping
rotateDamping.description:
The rotate damping. In the range 0 to 1, where a value of 0 means no damping and 1 means full
damping. The damping is applied to both the fly and orbit modes.
rotateDamping.title: Rotate Damping

moveDamping.name: moveDamping
moveDamping.description:
The move damping. In the range 0 to 1, where a value of 0 means no damping and 1 means full
damping. The damping is applied to the fly mode and the orbit mode when panning.
moveDamping.title: Move Damping

zoomDamping.name: zoomDamping
zoomDamping.description:
The zoom damping. In the range 0 to 1, where a value of 0 means no damping and 1 means full
damping. The damping is applied to the orbit mode.
zoomDamping.title: Zoom Damping

pitchRange.name: pitchRange
pitchRange.description:
The pitch range. In the range -360 to 360 degrees. The pitch range is applied to the fly mode
and the orbit mode.
pitchRange.title: Pitch Range

yawRange.name: yawRange
yawRange.description:
The yaw range. In the range -360 to 360 degrees. The pitch range is applied to the fly mode
and the orbit mode.
yawRange.title: Yaw Range

mobileInputLayout.name: mobileInputLayout
mobileInputLayout.description:
The layout of the mobile input. The layout can be one of the following:

- `joystick-joystick`: Two virtual joysticks.
- `joystick-touch`: One virtual joystick and one touch.
- `touch-joystick`: One touch and one virtual joystick.
- `touch-touch`: Two touches.

Default is `joystick-touch`.
mobileInputLayout.title: Use Virtual Gamepad

radiusScale.name: radiusScale
radiusScale.description: Bounding sphere radius multiplier for easier aiming

distanceSpeed.name: distanceSpeed
distanceSpeed.description: Push/pull speed in meters per second

rotateSpeed.name: rotateSpeed
rotateSpeed.description:
物体旋转速度，单位：度/秒（摇杆推满时的角速度）。

2026-10-25：经实机对比确认，调高到 270/540 会出现「转不过去」，
恢复为 90（即 ardemo34 正常时的值）。
根因：单帧转角 = rotateSpeed * dt，四元数累乘要求单帧 < 180°；
掉帧时 dt 放大，高转速下单帧转角逼近或越过临界，四元数走最短路径
⇒ 视觉上表现为跳变 / 反向 / 转不动。

注意旧注释写的 "radians per second" 不准确 —— 引擎的
Quat.setFromAxisAngle(axis, angle) 内部会乘 DEG_TO_RAD，传入的就是「度」。

groundY.description: Ground plane height (models never sink below this)

twoHandReleaseGraceMs.name: twoHandReleaseGraceMs
twoHandReleaseGraceMs.description:
Grace window (ms) after a two-hand scale during which a staggered trigger
release is treated as a simultaneous release.

rotateClampTolerance.name: rotateClampTolerance
rotateClampTolerance.description:
旋转时允许被穿地预演拒绝的容差（米）。旋转让 AABB 最低点下移、
clampAboveGroundY 要抬超过此值时，本帧不提交该旋转角。

maxRotateStepDeg.name: maxRotateStepDeg
maxRotateStepDeg.description:
单帧最大旋转角（度）。四元数乘法走最短路径，单帧转角逼近 180° 会
反向跳；单帧角 = rotateSpeed × dt，掉帧时 dt 放大 —— 此处硬截断，
任何帧率下都不会越过临界。

menuItems.name: menuItems
menuItems.description:
Array of menu item definitions. Item kinds:
- Interactive button: `{ label, eventName }` — fires `app.fire(eventName)` when activated.
- Label (read-only): `{ label }` — non-interactive; update via {@link XrMenu#setItemLabel}.
- Number row: `{ type: 'number', label, value, decEvent, incEvent }` — a single line with a
  `label: value` readout and '-' / '+' buttons firing `decEvent` / `incEvent`. Update the
  value via {@link XrMenu#setItemValue}.

clickSound.name: clickSound
clickSound.description: Audio asset for button click sound.

fontAsset.name: fontAsset
fontAsset.description: Font asset for button text. Required for text rendering.

menuOffset.name: menuOffset
menuOffset.description:
Offset from the anchor point where the menu appears.
For hand tracking: Z is distance from palm center along the palm normal.
For controllers: Applied in controller-local space.

buttonSpacing.name: buttonSpacing
buttonSpacing.description: Vertical spacing between menu buttons in meters.

buttonWidth.name: buttonWidth
buttonWidth.description: Width of each button in meters.

buttonHeight.name: buttonHeight
buttonHeight.description: Height of each button in meters.

fontSize.name: fontSize
fontSize.description: Font size for button text in UI pixels.

menuScale.name: menuScale
menuScale.description: Overall scale multiplier for the entire menu.

followSpeed.name: followSpeed
followSpeed.description: How quickly the menu follows the anchor point. Higher values = snappier movement.

palmUpThreshold.name: palmUpThreshold
palmUpThreshold.description:
Dot product threshold for detecting palm-up gesture. Higher values require the palm
to face more directly toward the camera.

toggleButtonIndex.name: toggleButtonIndex
toggleButtonIndex.description:
Gamepad button index used to toggle the menu in controller mode.
Default is 4 (typically Y button on left controller, B on right).

preferredHand.name: preferredHand
preferredHand.description: Which hand the menu should be attached to ('left' or 'right').

touchDistance.name: touchDistance
touchDistance.description: Distance threshold for finger touch hover in meters.

pressCooldown.name: pressCooldown
pressCooldown.description: Cooldown time after button press before another press is allowed (seconds).

buttonColor.name: buttonColor
buttonColor.description: Background color of menu buttons. Default is a dark slate so white text reads cleanly.

hoverColor.name: hoverColor
hoverColor.description:
Color of menu buttons when hovered. Default matches the typical XR pointer-ray cyan so
"ray on button" reads as a single visual feedback loop.

pressColor.name: pressColor
pressColor.description: Color of menu buttons when pressed/activated.

labelTextOpacity.name: labelTextOpacity
labelTextOpacity.description:
Opacity multiplier applied to text on label-only items (those declared without an
`eventName`). Used so interactive buttons read as the primary affordance and label rows
sit visually behind them. Range 0..1.

buttonTexture.name: buttonTexture
buttonTexture.description: Optional texture asset for button backgrounds.

fadeDuration.name: fadeDuration
fadeDuration.description: Duration of fade in/out animation in seconds.

alwaysVisible.name: alwaysVisible
alwaysVisible.description:
When true, the menu is shown for the full duration of the XR session and follows the
camera, rather than being toggled by the palm-up gesture or controller button. Hand-tracking
finger-touch and controller-ray interaction still work. Useful for debug HUDs.

followDistance.name: followDistance
followDistance.description: Distance in meters in front of the camera to place the menu when {@link alwaysVisible} is on.

followOffset.name: followOffset
followOffset.description:
Lateral and vertical offset in meters applied in camera-local space when
{@link alwaysVisible} is on. `x` is positive-right, `y` is positive-up.

cursorTexture.name: cursorTexture
cursorTexture.description:
射线光标贴图（项目素材 ring.png）。

当**右手柄**射线对准菜单时，在命中点显示这个圆环，告诉用户"射线现在指在菜单哪里"。
留空则不显示光标（功能自动禁用），不影响其余逻辑。

cursorSize.name: cursorSize
cursorSize.description:
射线光标直径，单位米。

ring.png 是 32×32 且四周有透明边，这里按不透明区域换算，使"看得见的环直径"等于该值。

cursorColor.name: cursorColor
cursorColor.description: 射线光标颜色。默认白色。

cursorPickInterval.name: cursorPickInterval
cursorPickInterval.description: 控制器模式下射线拾取的最小间隔（秒）。设为 0 = 每帧拾取。

audioAssetId.name: audioAssetId
audioAssetId.description: 要播放的音频资产 id。

buttonIndex.name: buttonIndex
buttonIndex.description: 触发切换的手柄按键索引，默认 4 对应左手柄 Y 键。

leftHandOnly.name: leftHandOnly
leftHandOnly.description: 只响应左手柄。关掉则左右手都响应。
